message.content:
This editorial illustration features a magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large grey letters across the top. Below the title, three figures in dark suits and black shoes are surfing atop a massive wave of white, granular matter. Each surfer stands on a red surfboard. One surfer is on the far left, while the other two are on the right, angling downwards.

The wave consists of tiny white specks resembling grains. In the foreground, three figures wearing conical hats and tan or green tunics flee from the approaching wave across a brown ground. One figure on the right runs forward with arms outstretched, while another runs in the center, and a third is crouched or fallen on the far left.

Bold black text in the center reads: "MAIN POLITIK IMPOR BERAS". Smaller text below reads: "Rencana pemerintah mengimpor 1 juta ton beras menuai kontroversi. Petani jadi tumbal perseteruan elite." At the top, two headlines read "GERILYA PERDANA CALON PRESIDEN" and "PANASNYA SIDANG RIZIEQ SYIHAB". The bottom left corner includes a QR code, a barcode, and the date "29 MARET-4 APRIL 2021".
